paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: Pop_GT, Pop_Ge in incorrectly answered samples and Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge) in correctly answered samples.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the relationship between knowledge popularity and the performance of large language models (LLMs) across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, with the vertical axis representing popularity on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 220. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into these three domains, each containing multiple bars representing different models or conditions, distinguished by color and pattern. The legend identifies six groups: Llama3 (solid blue), Qwen2 (solid red), ChatGPT (solid yellow), Acc=0 & GT Ans (blue with diagonal stripes), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (red with crosshatch pattern), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (yellow with horizontal stripes). Within each category, the bars are arranged to show the popularity values for these different conditions. For instance, in the "Basketball" category, the tallest bar corresponds to Qwen2 (red solid), reaching a popularity value of approximately 200, while the shortest is Acc=0 & GT Ans (blue diagonal stripes), at around 100. The bars for Acc=0 & GT Ans and Acc=0 & Gene Ans are consistently lower than their corresponding Acc=1 & GT Ans counterparts in each category, indicating a potential difference in performance based on accuracy. The chart shows that popularity values increase significantly from "Movies" to "Basketball," with the "Basketball" category displaying the highest overall popularity across all conditions. The bars are arranged in a consistent order across categories, with the models and conditions maintaining the same relative positions, suggesting a structured comparison.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different knowledge categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—across various large language models (LLMs) including Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT, as well as performance metrics based on accuracy and ground truth answers. The vertical axis represents popularity on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data into the three domains. For each domain, there are multiple bars representing different models and answer types: Llama3 (blue with diagonal stripes), Qwen2 (red with crosshatch pattern), and ChatGPT (yellow with diagonal lines), along with two additional categories: "Acc=0 & GT Ans" (black with dots) and "Acc=1 & GT Ans" (white with black outline). In the Movies category, all models show relatively low popularity, with Llama3 having the highest value around 40, followed by Qwen2 at approximately 30, and ChatGPT at about 20. In the Songs category, popularity increases, with Llama3 reaching approximately 70, Qwen2 around 65, and ChatGPT around 60. The "Acc=0 & GT Ans" and "Acc=1 & GT Ans" bars are much shorter, indicating lower popularity in incorrect and correct answer cases, respectively. In the Basketball category, popularity peaks significantly, with Llama3 reaching about 180, Qwen2 surpassing 200, and ChatGPT around 170. The "Acc=0 & GT Ans" and "Acc=1 & GT Ans" bars remain low, with values around 10 and 20 respectively. The chart shows that Qwen2 generally has the highest popularity in correctly answered samples, particularly in Basketball, while Llama3 and ChatGPT show similar trends across domains. The visual data suggests that knowledge popularity varies significantly by domain and model, with Basketball being the most popular domain overall.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Popularität verschiedener Kategorien – Movies, Songs und Basketball – für sechs verschiedene Modelle oder Ansätze: Llama3, Qwen2, ChatGPT, Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=0 & Gene Ans sowie Acc=1 & GT Ans. Die vertikale Achse repräsentiert die Popularität mit einem Wertebereich von 20 bis 220, wobei die Beschriftungen in Schritten von 20 angegeben sind. Die horizontalen Achsen enthalten die drei Kategorien Movies, Songs und Basketball, wobei jeder Kategorie eine Gruppe von sechs Balken zugeordnet ist, die jeweils einem der sechs Modelle oder Ansätze entsprechen. Die Balken sind farblich und durch Muster unterschieden: Llama3 ist blau mit diagonalen Streifen, Qwen2 rot mit diagonalen Streifen, ChatGPT gelb mit diagonalen Streifen, Acc=0 & GT Ans grau mit Punkten, Acc=0 & Gene Ans schwarz mit diagonalen Strichen und Acc=1 & GT Ans weiß mit einem weißen Rand. Die Balken innerhalb jeder Kategorie sind in einer Reihenfolge angeordnet, die den Modellnamen oder Ansatzbezeichnungen entspricht. Die Höhe der Balken variiert je nach Kategorie und Modell; so ist der höchste Balken in der Kategorie Basketball bei Qwen2 mit einem Wert von etwa 200, während der niedrigste Balken in der Kategorie Movies bei Acc=0 & GT Ans mit einem Wert von etwa 20 liegt. Die Balken in der Kategorie Basketball sind deutlich höher als in den Kategorien Movies und Songs.
